facts.fact: The Ministry of Innovation & Technology put its five-year e-governance strategy up for final public consultation the week before 13 July 2024, and the minister says its financing is still pending.
Addis Fortune reports the five-year e-governance plan requires a USD 40 million investment, excluding infrastructure costs.
